verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs show conversations organized into channels and topics, with public, web-public and private channel types. Some membership rules are documented: subscribing to a channel, guests barred from self-subscribing to public channels, and 'advanced roles and permissions' bundled at no extra cost. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of admin tools for adding or removing members of private channels, controls over who can create or join each channel type, and independent hands-on corroboration of membership management.
